name: Home Assistant
description: Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.
summary: Home Assistant allows AI-assisted code and documentation, including fully generated code, and AI help with issue and pull-request text, comments and reviews, provided a human reviews and understands the work and can explain it. Autonomous agents and AI-written answers to maintainer questions are not allowed; some repositories also require honest answers to AI questions in pull request templates.

AI can be a helpful tool to write code and documentation. But our projects are open source foundations that many people build on, so we require a human in the loop who understands the work the AI produced.
